subject.title: Feishu: benign non-zero exec exit codes render as "Exec failed" in tool-progress and interrupt streaming; no per-channel toolProgress toggle

question: Should Feishu adopt the shared nested streaming preview policy for `streaming.preview.toolProgress` and `streaming.preview.commandText`, and should `channels.feishu.streaming` remain protected from gateway `config.patch`?
rationale: The source problem is clear, but the fix changes Feishu's public config shape and potentially the gateway mutation boundary, so automation should not choose the permanent product/security posture alone.

options.title: Adopt shared Feishu preview policy
options.body: Extend Feishu to accept the shared nested streaming preview config, preserve current CardKit defaults, document the new policy, and keep `channels.feishu.streaming` protected unless reviewed separately.

options.title: Only adjust command wording
options.body: Rely on the current shared `exit N` wording and keep Feishu boolean-only, which reduces alarm but still gives Feishu users no way to keep streaming while hiding progress lines.

options.title: Allow coarse gateway toggle
options.body: Add `channels.feishu.streaming` to the gateway mutation allowlist, which gives agents a recovery toggle but broadens an operator-controlled path and does not provide status-only progress.

recommendation.title: Adopt shared Feishu preview policy
recommendation.body: Extend Feishu to accept the shared nested streaming preview config, preserve current CardKit defaults, document the new policy, and keep `channels.feishu.streaming` protected unless reviewed separately.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue is primarily Feishu plugin config and UX policy, and the package metadata names this handle as the community-maintained plugin owner signal.
